title: The Quiet Authority, One Word Under All of Them: Immanu, Week 7 (Psalm 46:1, Psalm 46:7, Psalm 84:11)

scripture.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

teaching_blocks.reflection: Trouble is not a place you walk into alone. Before you can name what is wrong, He is already near. A very present help is not far off, and it is not late. He is with you in it.

scripture.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

teaching_blocks.reflection: The word under this verse is Immanu. It means with us. The LORD of hosts is with us, and the God of Jacob is our refuge. He did not send help from a distance. He came near.

scripture.text: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

teaching_blocks.reflection: The sun and the shield are given by the One who is with you. He gives grace and glory, and He holds back no good thing from the one who walks uprightly. Walk on. He is with you.

scripture.text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved. For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

closing.prayer: LORD, You are my refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. I do not face this day alone. You are the LORD of hosts, and You are with us. Immanu. The God of Jacob is my refuge. You are my sun and my shield. You give grace and glory, and You hold back no good thing from me as I walk before You. I rest in Your nearness, steady and unafraid. In Jesus' name, Amen.
